Enum Class ControlPanelFeature

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ControlPanelFeature>
io.micronaut.pyronaut.config.model.ControlPanelFeature
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ControlPanelFeature>, Constable
public enum ControlPanelFeature extends Enum<ControlPanelFeature>
Optional Micronaut Control Panel modules that Pyronaut adds to a development Control Panel launch only when the application already depends on the library the panel inspects.

The Python CLI keeps an equivalent table in pyronaut_cli_v2/cli.py (_CONTROL_PANEL_FEATURES).

    • detectClasspath

      public static Set<ControlPanelFeature> detectClasspath(Collection<Path> classpath)
      Detects the panels enabled by an application classpath. Entries are matched by their versioned JAR file name, which is stable across Maven and Gradle repository layouts.
      Parameters:
      classpath - application classpath entries
      Returns:
      the matching panels

    • select

      public static List<Path> select(List<Path> bundled, Collection<Path> applicationClasspath)
      Selects the bundled Control Panel entries for a launch. Optional panel modules are kept only when the application classpath contains the library the panel inspects; every other entry is kept.
      Parameters:
      bundled - bundled Control Panel classpath entries
      applicationClasspath - application classpath entries
      Returns:
      the entries to add to the launch classpath
